gates.requirement: Bounded use case, owners and authorised data/environment access
Reconciled identities, units, acquisition/receipt time and installation effectivity
Independent prediction/uncertainty/alert evaluation within declared model support
Verified geometry/configuration and effective component mapping, or accepted illustrative restriction
Operator task policy, qualifications, calendars, parts, deadlines and approval authority
Target-environment security, identity scope, secrets, monitoring and restore acceptance
Representative users correctly complete workflows and interpret uncertainty/failure states
Frozen shadow/prospective evaluation, denominator, baseline, sample support and stopping rules
Observed outcomes, adverse cases, confounders and independent accept/restrict/reject decision

instructions: Local demonstration checks are references, not automatic passes for these operator gates.
Record failed and inconclusive results as well as successful results.
Mark a gate accepted only with its agreed criterion, evidence, authorised owner and decision reference.
A physical-model claim additionally requires the separate evaluated physical-twin gate in qualification.md.
